text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it, I've been so 
busy lately that I've slacked off on 
coming up with special moves.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm always coming up with ideas 
effortlessly, so alright, time to make up 
for slacking off!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugah! It's no good! I can't think of 
anything at all! Why is that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Biko Pegasus still has lingering 
fatigue from her race. It might be wise to 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule...
